factual_accuracy: Every material claim is supported by the supplied original-source evidence.
Plans and intentions are not presented as completed achievements.
Qualifications and geographic scope are preserved.
No invented consequence or materially misleading omission is introduced.
house_style_v04: The summary normally contains exactly two succinct sentences and no more than 50 words.
Sentence one begins with the exact source_name and uses publication-time source voice.
Disability relevance and the assigned specialist Category are clear.
Sentence two adds a concrete, source-supported detail without unnecessary repetition.
The language is original, grammatical and natural UK English.

no_automatic_threshold: No overall editorial pass threshold was invented for this five-article exploratory sample.
